1.sahih_international: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
1.pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
1.yusuf_ali: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
1.shakir: There surely came over man a period of time when he was a thing not worth mentioning.
1.muhammad_sarwar: There was certainly a time when there was no mention of the human being.
1.mohsin_khan: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was nothing to be mentioned?
1.arberry: Has there come on man a while of time when he was a thing unremembered?

2.sahih_international: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
2.pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
2.yusuf_ali: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
2.shakir: Surely We have created man from a small life-germ uniting (itself): We mean to try him, so We have made him hearing, seeing.
2.muhammad_sarwar: We created the human being from the union of sperm and egg to test him. We gave him hearing and vision.
2.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah drops of mixed semen (discharge of man and woman), in order to try him, so We made him hearer, seer.
2.arberry: We created man of a sperm-drop, a mingling, and We made him hearing, seeing.

3.sahih_international: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
3.pickthall: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
3.yusuf_ali: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
3.shakir: Surely We have shown him the way: he may be thankful or unthankful.
3.muhammad_sarwar: We showed him the right path whether he would be grateful or ungrateful.
3.mohsin_khan: Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
3.arberry: Surely We guided him upon the way whether he be thankful or unthankful.

4.sahih_international: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
4.pickthall: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
4.yusuf_ali: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
4.shakir: Surely We have prepared for the unbelievers chains and shackles and a burning fire.
4.muhammad_sarwar: We have prepared chains, shackles, and flaming fire (for the disbelievers).
4.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.
4.arberry: Surely We have prepared for the unbelievers chains, fetters, and a Blaze.

5.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
5.pickthall: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
5.yusuf_ali: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
5.shakir: Surely the righteous shall drink of a cup the admixture of which is camphor
5.muhammad_sarwar: The virtuous ones will drink from a cup containing camphor
5.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Abrar (pious, who fear Allah and avoid evil), shall drink a cup (of wine) mixed with water from a spring in Paradise called Kafur.
5.arberry: Surely the pious shall drink of a cup whose mixture is camphor,

6.sahih_international: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
6.pickthall: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
6.yusuf_ali: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
6.shakir: A fountain from which the servants of Allah shall drink; they make it to flow a (goodly) flowing forth.
6.muhammad_sarwar: which flows from a spring from which the servants of God will drink.
6.mohsin_khan: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.
6.arberry: a fountain whereat drink the servants of God, making it to gush forth plenteously.

7.sahih_international: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
7.pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
7.yusuf_ali: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
7.shakir: They fulfill vows and fear a day the evil of which shall be spreading far and wide.
7.muhammad_sarwar: The servants of God fulfill their vows and are afraid of the day in which there will be widespread terror.
7.mohsin_khan: They (are those who) fulfill (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.
7.arberry: They fulfil their vows, and fear a day whose evil is upon the wing;

8.sahih_international: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
8.pickthall: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
8.yusuf_ali: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
8.shakir: And they give food out of love for Him to the poor and the orphan and the captive:
8.muhammad_sarwar: They feed the destitute, orphans, and captives for the love of God, saying,
8.mohsin_khan: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to Miskin (poor), the orphan, and the captive,
8.arberry: they give food, for the love of Him, to the needy, the orphan, the captive:

9.sahih_international: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
9.pickthall: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
9.yusuf_ali: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
9.shakir: We only feed you for Allah's sake; we desire from you neither reward nor thanks:
9.muhammad_sarwar: "We only feed you for the sake of God and we do not want any reward or thanks from you.
9.mohsin_khan: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allah's Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.
9.arberry: 'We feed you only for the Face of God; we desire no recompense from you, no thankfulness;

10.sahih_international: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
10.pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
10.yusuf_ali: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
10.shakir: Surely we fear from our Lord a stern, distressful day.
10.muhammad_sarwar: We are afraid of our Lord and the bitterly distressful day".
10.mohsin_khan: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislikeness to it)."
10.arberry: for we fear from our Lord a frowning day, inauspicious.

11.sahih_international: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
11.pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
11.yusuf_ali: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
11.shakir: Therefore Allah win guard them from the evil of that day and cause them to meet with ease and happiness;
11.muhammad_sarwar: God will certainly rescue them from the terror of that day and will meet them with joy and pleasure.
11.mohsin_khan: So Allah saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadratan (a light of beauty) and joy.
11.arberry: So God has guarded them from the evil of that day, and has procured them radiancy and gladness,

12.sahih_international: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
12.pickthall: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
12.yusuf_ali: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
12.shakir: And reward them, because they were patient, with garden and silk,
12.muhammad_sarwar: For their patience, He will reward them with Paradise and silk.
12.mohsin_khan: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.
12.arberry: and recompensed them for their patience with a Garden, and silk;

13.sahih_international: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
13.pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
13.yusuf_ali: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
13.shakir: Reclining therein on raised couches, they shall find therein neither (the severe heat of) the sun nor intense cold.
13.muhammad_sarwar: They will recline therein on couches and they will find neither excessive heat nor cold.
13.mohsin_khan: Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).
13.arberry: therein they shall recline upon couches, therein they shall see neither sun nor bitter cold;

14.sahih_international: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
14.pickthall: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
14.yusuf_ali: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
14.shakir: And close down upon them (shall be) its shadows, and its fruits shall be made near (to them), being easy to reach.
14.muhammad_sarwar: The shades of the garden will be closely spread over them and it will be easy for them to reach the fruits.
14.mohsin_khan: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.
14.arberry: near them shall be its shades, and its clusters hung meekly down,

15.sahih_international: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
15.pickthall: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
15.yusuf_ali: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
15.shakir: And there shall be made to go round about them vessels of silver and goblets which are of glass,
15.muhammad_sarwar: They will be served with silver dishes and crystal clear goblets.
15.mohsin_khan: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal,
15.arberry: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver, and goblets of crystal,

16.sahih_international: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
16.pickthall: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
16.yusuf_ali: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
16.shakir: (Transparent as) glass, made of silver; they have measured them according to a measure.
16.muhammad_sarwar: Also there will be crystal clear goblets of silver containing the exact measure of drink which they desire.
16.mohsin_khan: Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof according to their wishes.
16.arberry: crystal of silver that they have measured -- very exactly.

17.sahih_international: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
17.pickthall: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
17.yusuf_ali: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
17.shakir: And they shall be made to drink therein a cup the admixture of which shall be ginger,
17.muhammad_sarwar: They will drink cups containing (soft flowing) sparkling water
17.mohsin_khan: And they will be given to drink there a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabil (ginger, etc.),
17.arberry: And therein they shall be given to drink a cup whose mixture is ginger,

18.sahih_international: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
18.pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
18.shakir: (Of) a fountain therein which is named Salsabil.
18.arberry: therein a fountain whose name is called Salsabil.

19.sahih_international: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
19.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
19.yusuf_ali: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
19.shakir: And round about them shall go youths never altering in age; when you see them you will think them to be scattered pearls.
19.muhammad_sarwar: They will be served by immortal youths who look like scattered pearls.
19.mohsin_khan: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.
19.arberry: Immortal youths shall go about them; when thou seest them, thou supposest them scattered pearls,

20.sahih_international: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
20.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
20.yusuf_ali: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
20.shakir: And when you see there, you shall see blessings and a great kingdom.
20.muhammad_sarwar: If you were to see it, you would find it to be a great kingdom with great bounty.
20.mohsin_khan: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.
20.arberry: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.

21.sahih_international: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
21.pickthall: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
21.yusuf_ali: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
21.shakir: Upon them shall be garments of fine green silk and thick silk interwoven with gold, and they shall be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord shall make them drink a pure drink.
21.muhammad_sarwar: They will have fine green silk and brocade, and they will be decked with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will provide them with a drink of pure wine.
21.mohsin_khan: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.
21.arberry: Upon them shall be green garments of silk and brocade; they are adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord shall give them to drink a pure draught.

22.sahih_international: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
22.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
22.yusuf_ali: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
22.shakir: Surely this is a reward for you, and your striving shall be recompensed.
22.muhammad_sarwar: This will be their reward and their efforts will be appreciated.
22.mohsin_khan: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted."
22.arberry: Behold, this is a recompense for you, and your striving is thanked.'

23.sahih_international: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
23.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
23.yusuf_ali: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
23.shakir: Surely We Ourselves have revealed the Quran to you revealing (it) in portions.
23.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have revealed the Quran to you in gradual steps.
23.mohsin_khan: Verily! It is We Who have sent down the Quran to you (O Muhammad SAW) by stages.
23.arberry: Surely We have sent down the Koran on thee, a sending down;

24.sahih_international: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
24.pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
24.yusuf_ali: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
24.shakir: Therefore wait patiently for the command of your Lord, and obey not from among them a sinner or an ungrateful one.
24.muhammad_sarwar: So wait patiently for the command of your Lord and do not yield to any sinful or disbelieving person among them (people).
24.mohsin_khan: Therefore be patient (O Muhammad SAW) and submit to the Command of your Lord (Allah, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.
24.arberry: so be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and obey not one of them, sinner or unbeliever.

25.sahih_international: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
25.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
25.yusuf_ali: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
25.shakir: And glorify the name of your Lord morning and evening.
25.muhammad_sarwar: Mention the Name of your Lord, mornings and evenings.
25.mohsin_khan: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and 'Asr prayers].
25.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening

26.sahih_international: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
26.pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
26.yusuf_ali: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
26.shakir: And during part of the night adore Him, and give glory to Him (a) long (part of the) night.
26.muhammad_sarwar: Prostrate before Him and glorify Him extensively during the night.
26.mohsin_khan: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and 'Isha' prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).
26.arberry: and part of the night; bow down before Him and magnify Him through the long night.

27.sahih_international: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
27.pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
27.yusuf_ali: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
27.shakir: Surely these love the transitory and neglect a grievous day before them.
27.muhammad_sarwar: These people (disbelievers) love the worldly life and neglect the terrifying day which will come.
27.mohsin_khan: Verily! These (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).
27.arberry: Surely these men love the hasty world, and leave be behind them a heavy day.

28.sahih_international: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
28.pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
28.yusuf_ali: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
28.shakir: We created them and made firm their make, and when We please We will bring in their place the likes of them by a change.
28.muhammad_sarwar: We have created them and have given them strength. Had We wanted, We could have replaced them with another people like them.
28.mohsin_khan: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.
28.arberry: We created them, and We strengthened their joints; and, when We will, We shall exchange their likes.

29.sahih_international: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
29.pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
29.yusuf_ali: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
29.shakir: Surely this is a reminder, so whoever pleases takes to his Lord a way.
29.muhammad_sarwar: This chapter is a reminder. Let those who want, seek guidance from their Lord.
29.mohsin_khan: Verily! This (Verses of the Quran) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allah).
29.arberry: Surely this is a Reminder; so he who will, takes unto his Lord a way.

30.sahih_international: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
30.pickthall: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
30.yusuf_ali: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
30.shakir: And you do not please except that Allah please, surely Allah is Knowing, Wise;
30.muhammad_sarwar: (The virtuous mentioned in this chapter) want only what God wants. God is All-knowing and All-wise.
30.mohsin_khan: But you cannot will, unless Allah wills. Verily, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.
30.arberry: But you will not unless God wills; surely God is ever All-knowing, All-wise.

31.sahih_international: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
31.pickthall: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
31.yusuf_ali: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
31.shakir: He makes whom He pleases to enter into His mercy; and (as for) the unjust, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.
31.muhammad_sarwar: He admits to His mercy whomever He wants. For the unjust He has prepared a painful punishment.
31.mohsin_khan: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will and as for the Zalimun, (polytheists, wrong-doers, etc.) He has prepared a painful torment.
31.arberry: For He admits into His mercy whomsoever He will; as for the evildoers, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.
